data.one_liner: Official Mixpanel tracking SDK for Flutter analytics.
data.what_it_does: Provides tracking and analytics capabilities for Flutter applications using the Mixpanel API. Supports manual tracking, user properties, automatic events, and autocapture for clicks, rage clicks, and dead clicks.
use_when: You need to integrate Mixpanel analytics into your Flutter application
You want to track user events, properties, and automatic mobile analytics
avoid_when: You need a backend-agnostic logging framework like logger or sentry
Your app targets iOS versions below 15.0 or macOS below 12.0 when using v3.x
strengths: Official SDK developed and maintained by Mixpanel
Supports web, android, ios, and macos platforms
Includes autocapture features for clicks, rage clicks, and dead clicks
weaknesses: Requires minimum iOS 15.0 and macOS 12.0 for version 3.x
Web setup requires inserting a script tag into web/index.html
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the dependency to pubspec.yaml, initializing Mixpanel with your project token in Dart code, setting platform deployment targets for iOS and macOS, and adding a script tag to web/index.html for Flutter Web support.
